name: Thomas Miller
source:
The protagonist of the novel. Name can be customised by the player but the default is Thomas Miller.

His parents and little sister were killed in a plane crash six years before the start of the story. Thomas lived with his grandmother Allison after that until he left for college a few years ago. He is just returning from college at the start of the story. He is very close to his grandmother, both his aunts, and his cousin Catherine (or Kitty Cat as he calls her). 

He is a bit of a nudist, he often forgets that he is naked and thus involuntarily exposes himself to others. He also sleeps naked without a cover. Has a near perpetual boner and a huge penis. It is big enough that his grandmother (after walking in on him sleeping and seeing it) takes him to the doctor as she thinks it can't be normal. It turns out that he is fine, just extremely well endowed, but also that his semen is very potent (he has an above average chance of impregnating women).

Has sex with dozens of women (occasionally with more than one at the same time) with ages from 18 to 71 and white, black, arab, indian and japanese alike. Despite his sleeping around, he is a surprisingly caring lover and even the most casual of flings usually ends with them cuddling together. He also often sleep cuddling with women.
